name: confirm-dialog
purpose: A small confirmation dialog: a title, one sentence of description, and a Cancel plus a confirm button whose `variant` says how destructive the outcome is (`danger` for a removal or a discard, `primary` for a commit). The unsaved-changes guard uses the same shell; the `actions` slot replaces the two buttons when the guard can also save. Built from `Dialog`, `Panel` parts, `Button` and, for a typed confirmation, `Input`.
useWhen: Use ConfirmDialog whenever the person must confirm an action they started (delete, discard, publish), including typed-name confirmation; an agent asking to run a tool uses ToolApproval, and a modal with your own body uses Dialog.
Before a removal (Remove domain, Delete resource) or a re-run (Clear again).
When someone leaves a form with unsaved changes.
A deletion that needs typed confirmation: set `confirmation-phrase` to the resource name; the dialog renders the field and keeps the confirm button disabled until the text matches.
avoidWhen: A form of several fields → use `dialog` with your own body.
A settings save that needs no decision → use `save-bar`.
related: `dialog` — the overlay it composes; use it directly for anything that is not a yes-or-no decision.
`save-bar` — the unsaved-changes bar this dialog guards.
bestPractices: The confirm label repeats the verb of the title (Remove Domain, Discard changes), never OK or Yes.
`variant="danger"` only when the outcome removes or discards something; a commit is `primary`.
Close the dialog from `@confirm` once the action has run; keep it open with `loading` while it runs.

Typed confirmation has one rule everywhere: the reader types the resource name (`confirmation-phrase`), the match is case-sensitive after trimming the ends, the confirm button stays disabled until it matches, `Enter` in the field confirms once it matches, and the field empties every time the dialog opens. Do not hand-write the field.
Below `md` the buttons stack full width in DOM and focus order, Cancel above and the confirm button last at the bottom nearest the thumb, the same order as `save-bar`, `Dialog` and `Drawer` footers.

props.name: title
props.doc: The question or the outcome, as the dialog title.

props.name: description
props.doc: One sentence that says what happens on confirm.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.doc: Label of the confirm button. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Confirm`).

props.name: cancelLabel
props.doc: Label of the cancel button. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Cancel`).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner on the confirm button while the action runs; Cancel, `Esc` and the overlay stop closing the dialog until it clears.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the confirm button, for a confirmation that needs input first.

props.name: confirmationPhrase
props.doc: A phrase the reader must type, exactly and with the same case, before confirm enables; usually the resource name. Empty asks for no typing.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled (`v-model:open` unbound).

events.name: confirm
events.notes: The confirm button was activated; not emitted while `disabled`, `loading` or before the phrase matches.

events.name: cancel
events.notes: The cancel button was activated; the dialog closes. Not emitted while `loading`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.notes: The control that opens the dialog.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Body content under the description: a field, an alert.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Replaces the Cancel and confirm buttons; receives a close function.
